_about: Best current values for a board/card-level 3D model of the original MITS Altair 8800 (1975), compiled from the four notes files in ../sources/. Every value is given in inches (the unit of the sources) and millimetres. basis: doc = stated in a document, standard or museum record; artwork = measured on the 1:1 MITS PCB artwork; drawing = scaled from a to-scale drawing; photo = scaled from a photo; est = estimate. confidence: high = documented and corroborated; medium = one good source or a consistent measurement; low = estimate. The raw values, with every disagreement, are in dims-documents.json, dims-case-and-panel.json and dims-boards-and-backplane.json. Source keys are defined in ../sources/bibliography.md.

machine.note: The simulator's panel.svg shows this panel (shared with the 8800a). 1975 features: short round switch bats, 4-slot 88-EC expander boards wired together, hand-wired front-panel harness, fan optional (88-FAN).

depth.note: Sources disagree; likely depends on whether rear parts are counted. One tape measurement settles it.

case.value: Stock Optima enclosure, MITS P/N 100505: grey C-shaped top with louvres (2 rear #6-32 screws), blue bottom tray with front bezel; chassis slides in from the rear (4 #6-32 screws)

case_sheet_thickness.how_to_get: Measure a real case, or Clone cabinet drawings (close, not exact), or a 1970s Optima catalogue

louvre_pattern.how_to_get: Photos with scale (side views among the reference photos)

dress_panel.note: 16 15/32 x 6 17/32 x 3/32 in, a loose original; held by the bezel lip, no fasteners

visible_area.note: Scaled from the bezel width (17.0 in), +-2 %

grid_pitch_in_group.note: Lamps and switches of one octal group

row_pitch.note: Lamp row 1 to lamp row 2 to address switches to control switches

positions.value: Every lamp and switch centre relative to the A0 lamp: table in ../sources/notes-case-and-panel.md section 4.2; unrounded values in dims-case-and-panel.json

a0_lamp_from_visible_centre.note: x right, y up; +-0.1 in. Places the grid on the dress panel. Measure the NMAH loose panel or any original to reach +-1 mm

switches.value: 25 toggles: 17 latching ST-1-1-C (A0-A15 and power), 8 momentary centre-off ST-1-3-C; American Switch; short round bats (about 10 mm, est.); 1/4-40 bushing (modern APEM 5236 equivalent)

lamps.value: 36 red diffused LEDs, Litronix RL-21, likely 5 mm T-1 3/4 body

name_plate_height.note: Brushed aluminium, black ALTAIR 8800 COMPUTER and MITS logo; absent on some machines

sub_panel.how_to_get: Thickness and outline: measure; it carries the 25 switches and 4 #6-32 screws to the chassis

dc_board_spacers.note: 4 spacers, D/C board to sub-panel; later errata hold the board by the switch nuts only

body.note: Length along the connector x height; IEEE 696 allows 9.98-10.02 x up to 5.125 in

tab_offset_front_end.note: The short end is the front of the box

heat_sink_above_top_edge.note: 0.2-0.25 in; every card has a 7805 on a finned heat sink

orientation.value: On edge, front to back, component side facing the right side of the box (seen from the front)

part_positions.value: CPU and 1K RAM: measure on the 1:1 X1 artwork (facts only, no tracing). 4MCS, SIO, 2SIO: photos only
part_positions.confidence: high for CPU and 1K, low for the others

expander_board.note: 88-EC, front-to-back length x width across the slots; foil drawing scaled by the 0.125 in pad pitch

boards_max_in_case.note: 16 slots; one board standard. Further boards wired wire by wire (CCTALK-GUZIS-2005)

connector_mounting_holes_apart.note: The two card rails run under these

card_guide.note: From a reproduction STL (units assumed mm: 139.8 x 12.8 x 16.5); blue plastic U-channel, 2 per card

edge_connector_body.how_to_get: Measure, or a 1970s connector datasheet; green bodies, rows about 0.14-0.15 in apart (HJ-S100BUS, drawing p.65)

card_cage_height.how_to_get: About 5.5 in above the expander board (card guide STL); measure

card_rail_positions.how_to_get: Set by hole counts 13 / 21 / 9 in the perforated side members; the hole pitch is not documented. Scale from MFE-SN220081K-PHOTOS or measure

transformers.value: T1 7.5 VAC 8 A (P-6138), T2 8 VAC 1.2 A + 24 VAC CT 0.4 A, T3 11 VAC 0.3 A (133-P-5), all on the back panel, right rear

psu_board.note: +-10-15 %; on the cross member on 4 x 0.375 in spacers; six 3300 uF axial capacitors in a row

terminal_block.value: Two rows of 10, on the back panel left of the transformers

fan.value: Optional 88-FAN; early back panels have a round screened hole, later ones slots

length.note: Artwork split over two pages with no overlap found; stitch the halves or measure

harness.value: 62 loose wires plus 2 jumpers: numbered bus wires to the expander board's staggered holes, 8 data wires (about 16 in) to a 10-pin plug on the CPU's wafer connector, laced bundle down the right side

outline.how_to_get: No drawing found. Scale from the CC0 top view (Altair_8800_chasis.jpg) and MFE-SN220081K-PHOTOS using the 10 in cards and the 0.75 in slot pitch, or measure

back_panel_cutouts.how_to_get: Photos only (DERAMP-EARLY, VCCA-LOSTFOUND, not free); measure
